description: Local patched Rust source is integrated into the Aphrody Cargo workspace. Reference upstreams are read live; build-only checkouts are restored on demand.
rootNote: Used only for optional build-on-demand upstream inputs. Cargo no longer requires a sibling source directory.

reference.purpose: Bridge upstream reference; the build consumes only its patched crates.io package.

Tauri 3 branch; only crates/tauri-runtime-cef is read: the one desktop runtime (CEF + tauri-winit + GTK 4). The local patch for tauri-apps/tauri#16189 (patches/tauri-runtime-cef-3.0.0-alpha.5-glib-work-source.patch, base 3.0.0-alpha.5) is re-checked against it; drop the patch once upstream merges a fix.
reference.consumers: config/tauri-upstream.json patches (tauri-runtime-cef-glib-work-source) and debuggers; docs/guides/web/TAURI-DEBUG.md; vendor.toml

reference.purpose: In-process W3C WebDriver server for Tauri 2; reading base for the Tauri 3 downcast_ref patch.
Rust-native Tauri MCP; read for its hardening and tool surface.
reference.consumers: config/tauri-upstream.json debuggers; aphrody-mcp Tauri tools design

reference.purpose: Microsoft WSL; native WSL build recipe input.
WSL2 Linux kernel; kernel build recipe input.
kernel.org stable Linux with Rust-for-Linux; mainline kernel recipe input. `aphrody-wsl latest --apply` moves the pin.
Pinned Jan source for owner-authorized absorption; existing Aphrody capability owners remain canonical. Initial model-hub search adapted with Fuse.js 7.1.0; full parity pending.
reference.note: Pinned checkout: ../aphrody-py/vendor/jan. Root LICENSE Apache-2.0, Menlo Research 2025; selected search adaptation retains attribution. Python/JS ADK manifests declare AGPL-3.0; do not assume a uniform repository license.

reference.purpose: mistral.rs; Cargo git dependency (mistralrs) plus native integration reference.
Windows Terminal; WSL build recipe input.
WSLg; system distro build recipe input.
uv 0.12.23 (resolver, installer, Python manager; crates uv-* 0.0.90) pinned for the vu runtime of the planned vu monorepo; the fork carries no Aphrody patch yet.
reference.note: Fork aphrody-labs/uv created 2026-10-05, branch vu-pin-0.12.23 at the release commit. crates.io uv 0.12.23 and uv-* 0.0.90 carry .cargo_vcs_info.json sha1 46b84fd0 (verified). Cargo.lock: 737 packages, no git source, no ruff and no pyo3. The uv-* crates are internal components upstream; the CLI is the public interface.

reference.purpose: ruff 0.16.10 (linter, formatter; the ty crates live in the same tree) pinned for the vu runtime of the planned vu monorepo; the fork carries no Aphrody patch yet.
reference.note: Fork aphrody-labs/ruff created 2026-10-05, branch vu-pin-0.16.10 at the release commit. crates.io ruff 0.16.10 and ruff_* 0.0.16 carry .cargo_vcs_info.json sha1 3265ed1f (verified). Cargo.lock: 558 packages, no git source, no pyo3. ty 0.0.84 vendors ruff 11aaa39f, 107 commits older: no separate branch.

reference.purpose: PyO3 0.29.3, the version of the Aphrody workspace Cargo.lock, pinned for the CPython embedding of the vu runtime.
reference.note: Fork aphrody-labs/pyo3 created 2026-10-05, branch vu-pin-0.29.3 at tag v0.29.3. crates.io pyo3 and pyo3-ffi 0.29.3 carry .cargo_vcs_info.json sha1 451d99fd (verified). Static embedding of libpython is not first-class upstream. Checked by scripts/audit/workspace/vu-pins.ts.

reference.purpose: Prebuilt CPython 3.12.15 (default, the py workspace baseline) and 3.14.8 distributions (install_only_stripped and full archives) that the vu runtime embeds; consumed as release assets pinned by sha256, not forked.
reference.note: MPL-2.0 covers the build system; the distributions carry CPython (PSF-2.0) and the licences of their bundled libraries. The install_only_stripped sha256 equals the digest pinned by uv 0.12.23 (crates/uv-python/download-metadata.json). Minimum glibc of the gnu targets: 2.17 (running.rst).

integrated.note: Registry archive, not a Git clone. Preserve Tauri 3/security patches until an equivalent upstream release. Rust/JS/build/license files match the previous pinned Git tree before patching.
crates.io 0.7.0 archive, as extracted before the move. The patch gives the bundled C++ a private namespace so it does not collide with V8's own simdutf in the same process.
Patched per config/tauri-upstream.json patches; drop once a published release imports Manager.

integrated.hold: mistral.rs requires serde-saphyr = "0.0.16" (0.0.x caret is exact); a 0.0.29 or 1.x bump needs a mistral.rs API port first
integrated.note: Preserve the Mistral.rs YAML API while allowing SemVer-compatible regex 1.x required by OXC. The upstream test suite must pass against the workspace-selected regex version.

ML base crates of Koharu 0.83.5 (tag 0.83.5, commit 52bb4f55e2266f72c1523562a583c827ec191ceb) (bindgen, config, runtime, llama, llama-sys, torch, torch-sys, diffusion, diffusion-sys) integrated under crates/ml as aphrody-* packages: crates.io holds older koharu-* releases under the upstream names. Divergence from the tag is not yet audited, so no patch is recorded. On-disk contracts kept: ~/.koharu/config.toml, the `koharu` runtime store and the libkoharu-torch shim of koharu-rs/torch releases. The Koharu product crates live in aphrody-labs/shenron.

Obscura headless browser crates (obscura, obscura-browser, obscura-cdp, obscura-dom, obscura-js, obscura-mcp, obscura-net, obscura-render, obscura-ssrf) copied under crates/web as aphrody-obscura (facade) and obscura-* packages. Base: upstream main 1fccab2c1ecd0f7eadc16d7a520ba227f9e7f782 (2026-10-04), merged through the fork aphrody-labs/obscura branch yolo (dbea8a7, includes the fork SSRF commit 43ae887). Local changes are kept by three-way merge and listed in docs/reference/web/crates/aphrody-obscura/OBSCURA-UPSTREAM.txt; no patch file is recorded. vendor/taffy stays in aphrody-labs/taffy (git) and cosmic-text resolves to athena-text from crates.io.

Layout fork carrying the upstream Obscura layout changes. Integrated from the pinned revision (src, Cargo.toml, LICENSE, README, MIGRATION.json) as a path patch of crates-io so a build needs no SSH alias to the private repository (cloud sessions, CI, factory). Re-import from the fork revision to update.
